List Tables in a DuckDB Connection

Source: R/omicidx_client.R
list_tables.Rd

Retrieves a list of all tables available in a DuckDB connection, with optional filtering by database and/or schema.

Usage

list_tables(con, database = NA, schema = NA)

Arguments

con

A DuckDB database connection object created by connect_omicidx().

database

A character string specifying the database name to filter by. If NA (default), all databases are included.

schema

A character string specifying the schema name to filter by. If NA (default), all schemas are included.

Value

A tibble containing information about tables in the database, with columns for database, schema, table name, and other metadata.

Examples

con <- connect_omicidx()
# List all tables
list_tables(con)
#> # A tibble: 8 × 6
#>   database schema  name                  column_names column_types temporary
#>   <chr>    <chr>   <chr>                 <list>       <list>       <lgl>    
#> 1 omicidx  sources v_src_geo_platforms   <chr [20]>   <chr [20]>   FALSE    
#> 2 omicidx  sources v_src_geo_samples     <chr [26]>   <chr [26]>   FALSE    
#> 3 omicidx  sources v_src_geo_series      <chr [26]>   <chr [26]>   FALSE    
#> 4 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_accessions  <chr [21]>   <chr [21]>   FALSE    
#> 5 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_experiments <chr [28]>   <chr [28]>   FALSE    
#> 6 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_runs        <chr [17]>   <chr [17]>   FALSE    
#> 7 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_samples     <chr [13]>   <chr [13]>   FALSE    
#> 8 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_studies     <chr [17]>   <chr [17]>   FALSE    

# Filter by schema
list_tables(con)
#> # A tibble: 8 × 6
#>   database schema  name                  column_names column_types temporary
#>   <chr>    <chr>   <chr>                 <list>       <list>       <lgl>    
#> 1 omicidx  sources v_src_geo_platforms   <chr [20]>   <chr [20]>   FALSE    
#> 2 omicidx  sources v_src_geo_samples     <chr [26]>   <chr [26]>   FALSE    
#> 3 omicidx  sources v_src_geo_series      <chr [26]>   <chr [26]>   FALSE    
#> 4 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_accessions  <chr [21]>   <chr [21]>   FALSE    
#> 5 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_experiments <chr [28]>   <chr [28]>   FALSE    
#> 6 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_runs        <chr [17]>   <chr [17]>   FALSE    
#> 7 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_samples     <chr [13]>   <chr [13]>   FALSE    
#> 8 omicidx  sources v_src_sra_studies     <chr [17]>   <chr [17]>   FALSE
